# Kastine Augak

> Official portfolio of Kastine Augak, a Uganda-based software developer and digital creator working across web and mobile software, applied AI, education technology, and creative media.

Canonical website: https://kamulindwaaugustine.netlify.app/

## About
Kastine Augak builds and explores practical digital products intended to make technology useful and accessible. Areas of work include responsive websites, mobile-first progressive web apps, AI-assisted learning and research tools, audio workflows, and digital storytelling.

## Selected projects
- SomaGPT: Education technology project exploring practical AI support for learning. https://soma-gpt.netlify.app/
- iVerifyAI: Claim-verification project concept focused on helping people assess online information. https://iverifyai.vercel.app/
- Stemit PWA: Mobile-first audio tool project and public source repository. https://github.com/Augak/stemit-pwa
- Public GitHub repositories: https://github.com/Augak?tab=repositories
- Projects directory: https://kamulindwaaugustine.netlify.app/projects.html
